name: zinput_on_app_deactivate
description: zInput::OnAppDeactivate suspends unsuspended joystick, mouse, and keyboard devices, clears mouse active state, and updates mouse acquisition.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly validates the IsUnsuspended/Suspend checks for joystick, mouse, and keyboard, then clearing g_zInput_MouseActive and tail-calling Mouse_UpdateAcquireState.
The native smoke verifies all three suspend flags are set and the mouse is unacquired.
